title: Samuel Krauss – digital edition: Griechische und lateinische Lehnwörter im Talmud, Midrasch und Targum (part II, 1899) and Talmudische Archäologie (vols. I–III, 1910–1912)
description: Transcription of two works of Samuel Krauss: the dictionary of Greek and Latin loanwords in Talmud, Midrash and Targum (part II, Berlin 1899, with notes by Immanuel Löw; 6,329 entries, as JSON and DSL) and the Talmudische Archäologie (3 vols., Leipzig 1910–1912; full text with 8,657 notes and 75 figures as JSON and Markdown, the index of vol. III as a dictionary, and the bibliography of cited works). Abbreviations explained, references resolved. Transcribed with Claude (Anthropic, 2026) from page images in eScriptorium; a working transcription, not a critical edition. Prepared for the Safran library (https://github.com/mitkin89/Safran).
